---
title: "GDP Blues: Unravelling the UK's Troubled Economic Slowdown"
description: "Four reasons behind the UK's anaemic 0.9% real GDP growth from 2019 to 2023, from collapsing consumer confidence to new post-Brexit trade barriers."
date: "2023-07-30"
categories: [other, brexit]
---

The UK's real GDP grew just 0.9% between 2019 and 2023, well behind
comparable economies, and this post traces that underperformance to four
compounding causes: weak consumer confidence dragging down domestic spending,
export growth stalled by new post-Brexit trade barriers, falling imports
signalling reduced participation in global supply chains, and a recovery
propped up disproportionately by government spending rather than private
investment. Fixing the structural issues, not just riding out the cycle, is
what the piece argues Britain actually needs.

**Originally published on Substack**, July 30, 2023.
